compat.text: If the membrane does not adhere to other elements, lift and retorch the unbonded areas. 1. Seasonal symbol Note: If a seasonal symbol is printed on the roll’s label, it is advisable to use the membrane during the indicated season
compat.heading: APPLICATION

compat.text: Unroll the membrane. 1. Align the membrane. 2. Re-roll the membrane before application. 3. MEMBRANE OVERLAPS Overlap the membranes by a minimum of 100 mm on the sides and 150 mm on each end. 1. At the end overlap, cut off a corner measuring 100 mm per side at an angle of 45°. 2. Weld the overlaps with great care until you see a trickle of melted mixture about 10 mm wide coming out along the line of the overlap. 3. TORCHING Heat the substrate and the backing film on the underside of the membrane with a gas burner. 1. When the backing film starts to melt, the membrane is ready to stick. 2. Roll the heated membrane forward and press it firmly against the substrate to bond it. 3. Make sure a bead of melted bitumen is visible along the full length of the overlap sides and ends when laying. 4. Suitable substrates for torching Concrete
